Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 56 s. 2022 June 30, 2022 HON. RONALDO B. GOLEZ Municipal Mayor Dumangas, Iloilo HON. WILFREDO T. CORDERO Punong Barangay Barangay Bacong Dumangas, Iloilo Gentlemen: This pertains to the letter dated 2 February 2022 of Punong Barangay (PB) Wilfredo T. addressed to Municipal Mayor Ronaldo B. Golez, to which the Department was copy fumished. Per the letter, it was represented that the 6th ranking Sangguniang Barangay (SB) Member died on October 1, 2021. In order to fill up the vacancy, the SB of Barangay Bacong passed Resolution Nos. 02 and 20, entitled "A RESOLUTION DECLARING THE VACANT SEAT OF THE NO. 6 BARANGAY KAGAWAD HON. DIINDO ALARCON WHO PASSED AWAY LAST OCTOBER 1, 2021 AND HEREBY RECOMMENDING MR. EDISON D. DUOT TO FILL UP THE VACANT POSITION" and "A RESOLUTION RECOMMENDING EDISON D. DUOT FOR THE VACANT POSITION OF BARANGAY KAGAWAD OF BARANGAY BACONG, DUMANGAS, ILOILO", dated October IO, 2021 and October 21, 2021, respectively. It was also represented that representatives/the recommendee himself, have been going back and forth to the Office of the Mayor asking to extend to him the appointment for the vacant position subject of the Resolutions. However, the Mayor keeps on asserting that the barangay should submit a list of several recommendees from which the Mayor will choose one to appoint. Hence, PB Cordero's call for the urgent need to appoint Mr. Duot Primarily, Section 441 of the Local Govemment Code of 1991 (LGC) categorically 1 Section 44. Permanent Vacancies in the Offices Of the Governor, Vice-Governor, Mayor, and Vice- Mayor - Xxx For purposes of this Chapter, a permanent vacancy arises when an elective local official fills a higher vacant office, refuses to assume office, fails to qualify, dies, iS removed from office, voluntarily resigns, or is otherwise permanently incapacitated to discharge the functions of his office. xxx "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

mentions "death" as one of the grounds that will give way to a permanent vacancy. The same provision mandates the application of the rule of automatic succession in case of permanent vacancy2. The basis for this rule is the ranking in the Sanggunian as determined by the proportion of votes obtained by each winning candidate to the total number of registered voters in the immediately preceding local election. The deceased SB Member ranked 6th in the sangguniang barangay, applying the rule on automatic succession, the 7th ranking SB Member shall now become the 6th ranking, the position permanently vacated by the late Dindo Alarcon. The resultant vacancy in the 7th ranking shall be filled-up in accordance with Section 45 of the LGC, thus: "Section 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. - (a) Permanent vacancies in the sanggunian where automatic succession provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: xxx xxx xxx (3) The city or municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay, upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concemed. (b) xxx xxx xxx (c) In case or permanent vacancy is caused by a sanggunian member who does not belong to any political party, the local chief executive shall, upon recommendation of the sanggunian concemed, appoint a qualified person to fill the vacancy. xxx xxx xxx" (Emphasis supplied) Based on the foregoing, where the rule of automatic succession is no longer applicable, the appointment will be issued by the municipal mayor upon the recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concerned, who shall be a "qualified person" which means that he possesses the qualifications for the position of SB Member under Section 393 of the LGC and none of the disqualifications enumerated 2 "xxx Subsequent vacancies in the said office shall be filled automatically by the other sanggunian members according to their ranking as defined herein." 3 Section 39. Qualifications. —xxx xxx xxx (e) Candidates for the position of punong barangay or member of the sangguniang barangay must be at least eighteen (18) years of age on election day. xxx Page 2 Of 3 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

under Section 404 and other pertinent laws. Hence, it should be the 7th ranking that should be filled-up and not the 6th ranking. With respect to the assertion of Mayor Golez that the barangay should submit a list of several recommendees from which the Mayor will choose one to appoint, the same is not tenable and has no legal basis. The LGC is explicit that municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay, shall appoint upon the recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concerned. Accordingly, the Department, pursuant to its delegated power of supervision over local government units and its officials, hereby instructs both of you to perform your duties appropriately, taking into consideration this legal opinion. For your compliance. Very truly yo BY THORITY OF T B. DINO HE SECRETARY: nd ecretary for Barangay Affairs O BNMB/LLLS-LRAL Copy furnished: DIR. JUAN E. INGENIERO, CESO Iv Regional Director, DILG-Region VI Fort San Pedro Dr, Iloilo City, Iloil 4 Section 40. Disqualifications. - The following persons are disqualified from running for any elective local position: (a) Those sentenced by final judgment for an offense involving moral turpitude or for an offense punishable by one (I) year or more of imprisonment, within two (2) years after serving sentence; (b) Those removed from office as a result of an administrative case; (c) Those convicted by final judgment for violating the oath of allegiance to the Republic; (d) Those with dual citizenship; (e) Fugitives from justice in criminal or non-political cases here or abroad; (f) Permanent residents in a foreign country or those who have acquired the right to reside abroad and continue to avail of the same right after the effectivity of this Code; and (g) The insane or feeble-minded.
